text:
Root cause: `Option.prompt_for_value` retrieved callable defaults with `call=False`, so the function object was displayed and passed through type conversion.

Changed it to evaluate the default via `self.get_default(ctx)` before prompting. This also fixes callable boolean defaults and preserves the evaluated value for both the prompt display and accepted default. All targeted tests pass.

final_text:
Root cause: `Option.prompt_for_value` retrieved callable defaults with `call=False`, so the function object was displayed and passed through type conversion.

Changed it to evaluate the default via `self.get_default(ctx)` before prompting. This also fixes callable boolean defaults and preserves the evaluated value for both the prompt display and accepted default. All targeted tests pass.
